issues.description: ELIXIR-DEV terminated on an API error ('Connection lost mid-response') during Step Final, after the rebase, push, PR creation, merge and branch cleanup had all completed but before it wrote its own result block. The work itself is unaffected and independently verified. The gap this exposes is in the audit trail rather than the repo: a step whose agent dies after acting but before reporting leaves a COMPLETED-in-reality / IN_PROGRESS-on-disk handoff, and nothing in HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md says who may write that result or how it must be marked. ORCH filled it here and labelled every field as ORCH-reconstructed-from-evidence rather than agent-reported, following the precedent of the orch_timestamp_correction field in handoffs/WF02-REQ023-20260816/step-06-doc-updater.json -- a reconstruction that is indistinguishable from a measurement defeats the audit trail it is meant to preserve. Worth a protocol note so the next occurrence does not have to re-derive the convention.
